entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need a return label for order 774-B-91. It's a helmet. Just tell me yes or no.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong color. It looked different online. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just need to send it back.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. So it's a color preference, and not an issue with the product's safety features. Let me just pull up your order details... one moment.
Alright, I see the order was delivered 25 days ago. That's no problem at all. Our policy allows for returns on standard items within 90 days, especially since the box is unopened.
Okay, good. So you're sending the label?
Yes. I have just approved the return and the system has sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Got it. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
